The Pitch shall not be completely covered during a match unless special regulations so provide; covers used to protect the bowlers’ run up shall not extend to a greater distance than 3½ feet in front of the Popping creases. When the start of play is delayed by weather Laws 14 and 15 shall apply in accordance with the number of days’ play remaining from the actual start of the match.

A match is won by the side which shall have scored a total of runs in excess of that scored by the opposing side in its two completed innings; one-day matches, unless thus played out, shall be decided by the first innings.
